description: This Java class implements a business step in a loan management system, specifically updating the arrears aging details of a loan. It is part of the Fineract project and interacts with a loan arrears update handler to perform its function.

classes.name: UpdateLoanArrearsAgingBusinessStep
classes.description: A Spring component that executes a business step to update the arrears aging details of a loan within the system.

methods.description: Performs the action of updating arrears aging details for the given loan using the handler.
